label: b51: lstmhist0 (recurrent PPO, LSTM 128, move history 0), seed 8 of 8, 100M
notes: Batch b51, Group E row E1 (plans/algoExploration/e-memory.md, local-only by decision 2026-09-30): recurrent PPO. b27's hist8 config verbatim (rollout 256, 128 lanes, 4 epochs, lr 2.5e-4, clip 0.2, huber, adv norm, grad 0.5, adam eps 1e-7, vf 0.5, target_kl 0, b2 reward = chase-safe 0.1 gate 75, step penalty 0.01, fc 320, horizon anneal to 50% of the cap: lambda 0.95->0.999, gamma 0.99->0.999, entropy 0.01->0.001) at 100M, plus SNEK_PPO_RECURRENT=lstm: an LSTM of 128 between trunk and head in BOTH towers (the critic has its own), each lane's state carried through the rollout, the update replaying whole lanes from the stored step-0 state (SNEK_PPO_SEQ_MINIBATCH=2 lanes x 256 = 512 transitions, b27's minibatch; SNEK_PPO_MINIBATCH=512 is the same number, kept so the spec reads as b27's). Two cells of 4 seeds: lstmhist8 (a-d, SNEK_OBS_HISTORY=8) read against b27's hist8 cell (b27q-x): does memory add to the window; lstmhist0 (e-h, SNEK_OBS_HISTORY=0) read against b27's hist0 cell (b27a-h) and against hist8: does memory replace the window. Registered prediction (the agent, 2026-09-30): lstmhist0 lands well above hist0 (49% density) and at or under hist8 (95%); lstmhist8 is level with hist8 within noise -- the window already carries what the body's recent path tells, and the LSTM's extra cost buys no density. Cost (benchmark 2026-09-30, laptop solo, 1 thread): 2,150 transitions/s against 54,000 feed-forward at this config -- the two-lane minibatch is a 256-step recurrence run 256 times an update -- so 100M is ~13 h solo and ~18 h in a 4-arm desktop wave. Judged on stage-B density, hof5000/hof30k rows and drawdowns at a common horizon. One observation width per wave of 4 on the desktop; a laptop wave of 8 mixes the two widths and runs its stage A in-process (tools/scheduler.py wave_obs_history), which is slower but correct.
